title: Download / Motion Toolkit
slide_intent: Expose the availability of production resources so designers know whether implementation files accompany the guidance.
strategic_value: A clear resource status can reduce confusion between displayed examples and downloadable tooling.
demonstration: A Download heading states that the Motion Toolkit will become available at the end of September. No download link is visible in this captured section.
practical_value: Treat this as a source availability notice; do not assume the toolkit has been downloaded or that the unspecified September establishes an edition date.

content_islands.name: Resource notice
content_islands.spec: Keep the heading and single availability sentence together on white.
